title: Integrated pest management basics guide
context: Smallholder farmers and extension workers need plain-language, source-cited guidance on integrated pest management basics.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to integrated pest management basics summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers integrated pest management basics as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no farm-specific prescriptions or pesticide dosing
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
